title: M8-02 — shrink loop wiring: proptest runtime dep + shrink() entry + per-variant dispatch + 5 unit tests (strategy implementations themselves are stubs, deferred to m8-03)

commits.subject: feat(services): m8-02 shrink loop wiring (proptest runtime dep + shrink() entry + per-variant dispatch)

new_public_api: pub struct ShrinkConfig { pub max_rounds: u32, pub seed: Option<u64> }
impl Default for ShrinkConfig { fn default() -> Self { /* 64, None */ } }
impl From<ShrinkConfig> for proptest::test_runner::Config { fn from(s) -> Config { /* cases = max(s.max_rounds, 1); rng_seed = Fixed(s.seed) or Random; Default::default() for the rest */ } }
pub enum CounterexampleRunError { NoViolation { reason: String }, RoundsExhausted { best_so_far: Option<CounterexampleBundle> }, AdapterFailed(String) }
impl From<CounterexampleRunError> for ServiceError { /* NoViolation→Unsupported, RoundsExhausted→Unsupported, AdapterFailed→EvalError */ }
ChronosCounterexampleService::shrink (async) — pub async fn shrink(ctx, input) -> Result<CounterexampleOutput, ServiceError>
internal_strategy_stubs: async fn shrink_invariant(&TestRunner, &CounterexampleContext<'_>, &HypothesisInput) -> Result<ShrinkResult, ServiceError> — returns (1, Some(target.constant), None, None)
async fn shrink_existence(&TestRunner, &CounterexampleContext<'_>, &HypothesisInput) -> Result<ShrinkResult, ServiceError> — returns (1, None, Some(target.predicate), None)
async fn shrink_call_path(&TestRunner, &CounterexampleContext<'_>, &HypothesisInput) -> Result<ShrinkResult, ServiceError> — returns (1, None, None, Some((caller, callee, depth)))
type ShrinkResult = (u32, Option<PropertyValue>, Option<ExistencePredicate>, Option<(String, String, Option<usize>)>)

output_extension.new_variant: CounterexampleOutput::Shrunk { bundle, rounds_used, minimised_constant, minimised_predicate, minimised_call_path }

lifecycle_changes: Lifted now_unix_ms() and fresh_bundle_id() out of #[cfg(test)] — production caller (shrink) needs them.

workspace_dep_promotion.disclosure: Compile-time cost: ~6-8s longer cargo check -p chronos-services per scope doc §7. Default features sufficient (no proptest-macro).

architectural_decisions.promote_proptest_to_runtime_dep: Justification: shrink() runs at session-tool invocation time, not at cargo test time. Dev-dep would force a feature flag. Runtime dep on chronos-services only (not workspace-wide) per A1 in M8 scoping.
architectural_decisions.shrunken_variant_per_field_some_none: Each Shrunk variant carries exactly one Some payload (constant for Invariant, predicate for Existence, call_path tuple for CallPath). Dictated by bundle.property_kind. m8-03 flattens to wire DTO.
architectural_decisions.counter_example_run_error_no_new_service: Reuse Unsupported for both NoViolation + RoundsExhausted (semantically: 'no smaller counterexample found'); EvalError for AdapterFailed. No new variants added. Matches m8-01's reuse-Unsupported precedent.
architectural_decisions.pre_validate_target_hypothesis_violates: shrink() first runs hypothesis_test::test on the original target_hypothesis. If Pass/Unsupported, returns Err(Unsupported) early — saves a useless shrink budget. Spec-grounded in the 'preserve the same property violation' constraint: we only shrink properties that ARE violated.
architectural_decisions.strategy_stubs_for_m8_02_signatures: m8-02 ships the per-variant dispatcher pattern + return-shape contracts but the actual proptest::TestRunner::run(&strategy, closure) loop is m8-03 scope (needs live QueryEngine map + sandbox smoke for real shrink verification). Stub bodies are honest: 'rounds_used=1, return the original input unchanged' is documented in counterexample::shrink_invariant § 4b.
architectural_decisions.config_struct_init_via_struct_update_syn: From<ShrinkConfig> for Config uses Config { cases: ..., rng_seed: ..., ..Default::default() } (not field-by-field reassignment) to satisfy clippy field_reassign_with_default lint.
architectural_decisions.no_chronos_cli_workspace_member_in_m8_02: Still m8-04. m8-02 only adds wiring; CLI shell-glue needs MCP wrappers first.

experimental_disclosures.title: HypothesisInput → proptest::Strategy adapter is non-trivial (per M8 doc C0)
experimental_disclosures.m8_02_status: STUB — three per-variant async fns are signatures + return shape only; the actual proptest Strategy impls (per-variant hand-rolled) are m8-03 scope.
experimental_disclosures.m8_03_resolution: Per-variant Strategy impls + proptest::TestRunner::run loop. Sandbox smoke against test_busyloop fixture verifies end-to-end shrink.

experimental_disclosures.title: proptest::TestRunner::run is synchronous-wrapper, not async
experimental_disclosures.m8_02_status: Outer shrink() is async (awaits hypothesis_test::test). Inner runner.run is not — the runner holds a single-thread TestRunner which we build via TestRunner::new(Config). Doc comment added.

experimental_disclosures.title: ExistencePredicate::EventTypeEquals shrink direction uses naive proptest string shrink
experimental_disclosures.m8_02_status: Stub does not run a real shrink — R3 is m8-03 scope. Will be addressed by per-variant Strategy impls there.

test_plan_completed.unit_tests_skipped_with_reason: Real shrink run against a known-failing hypothesis (e.g., invariant: event_count < 5 on busyloop trace) — requires live QueryEngine map; covered by m8-03 sandbox smoke.
test_plan_completed.sandbox_smoke_pending: m8-03 introduces MCP wrappers + redb bundle table; sandbox smoke against test_busyloop fixture verifies end-to-end shrink. n/a for m8-02.
